themes.name: Accessibility To Greenspace
inputs: Q14: easy to get to without a car
Q15: walk time to nearest greenspace

themes.name: Access Within Greenspace
inputs: Q14: inclusive for people of all abilities

themes.name: Quality
inputs: Q14: easy to navigate, with clear paths and signage
Q14: provide the amenities and facilities I need
Q14: rich in nature and wildlife

themes.name: Benefits
inputs: Q14: benefit my mental health and encourage physical activity
Q14: improve my sense of community

aggregation: Each theme total is expressed as a % of its maximum possible value; the four theme percentages are averaged (equal weights) to give the Overall Greenspace Index for each respondent, then aggregated across population groups/areas.
weighting: Equal weighting of inputs within themes and of the four themes in the overall score, per project steering group feedback — transparent, replicable, avoids subjective weightings.
